[Cache](/en/documentation/build/cache/) applies default limits to a [cache setting](/en/documentation/build/cache/cache-settings/), to an object it holds, and to a [Real-Time Purge](/en/documentation/build/cache/real-time-purge/) request. This page carries those bounds and what the platform answers past each one. It also carries the purges and the data transfer each service plan includes every month. Where a plan changes an amount, the table says so. To request a higher limit for the account, contact the [technical support](/en/documentation/support/) team.

---

## Default limits

The values below are the default limits Cache applies, grouped by what each one bounds. Where the API rejects a value past a bound, it answers with HTTP `400`. The Past the limit column then names the error code and the error title. Where no behavior past a value is documented, the column reads "Not documented".

### Cache setting

These bounds apply to one cache setting, whichever interface writes it. The Scope column names the API field beside the Console control. [Tiered Cache](/en/documentation/build/cache/tiered-cache/) changes two of them: the TTL floor and the cache behavior the setting accepts.

| Scope | Limit | Past the limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cache TTL minimum, **Max Age** (`modules.cache.max_age`) | 60 seconds; 0 seconds with [Application Accelerator](/en/documentation/build/application-accelerator/) on the application | Error `21021`, `Edge Cache Max Age Lower Than The Minimum Allowed By Application's Application Accelerator Module`. |
| Cache TTL minimum with Tiered Cache on | 3 seconds | Error `21020`, `Edge Cache Max Age Lower Than The Minimum Allowed By The Tiered Cache Module`. |
| Cache TTL maximum | 31,536,000 seconds, one year | Error `10068`, `Max Value`. |
| Cache behavior with Tiered Cache on (`modules.cache.behavior`) | _Override cache behavior_ only | Error `21001`, `It's Not Possible To Use This Edge Cache Behavior.` |
| Browser cache TTL (`browser_cache.max_age`) | 0 to 31,536,000 seconds | Error `10068`, `Max Value`. |
| Cache setting name, **Name** (`name`) | 250 characters | Error `10046`, `Max Length`. |
| Methods under **Cache vary by Method** (`cache_vary_by_method`) | 2 values | Not documented. The API specification caps the array at 2 values, and no error string is documented. |

### Cached object

Two bounds apply to the object Cache stores: the size of one object, and the size of each fragment under **Large file optimization**.

| Scope | Limit | Past the limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Large File Optimization fragment size (`modules.cache.large_file_cache.offset`) | 1,024 kB per fragment, fixed | Error `10068`, `Max Value`. To change the fragment size, contact the Sales team. |
| Single object in cache | 10 GB | Not documented. |

### Real-Time Purge

These bounds apply to a purge request, whichever interface sends it, and to the purge history.

| Scope | Limit | Past the limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| URL or cache key length | 4,096 characters | Not documented. |
| Objects in one URL or cache key purge request | 50 objects | Error `10065`, `List Field Max Length`, `Ensure this field has no more than 50 elements.` |
| URL and cache key purge requests per client | 200 requests, 50 objects each | Not documented. |
| URL and cache key purge, objects every 60 seconds | 10,000 objects | Not documented. |
| Wildcard purge requests per day, in a 24-hour interval | 2,000 requests | Not documented. |
| Wildcard length | 256 characters | Not documented. |
| Wildcards in one purge request | 1 wildcard | Error `10065`, `List Field Max Length`, `Ensure this field has no more than 1 elements.` |
| Requests kept in the purge history | 1,000,000 requests | Not documented. |
| Time a request stays in the purge history | 6 months | Not documented. |

---

## Included usage per plan

Azion offers three service plans: Hobby, Pro, and Enterprise. The amounts below bound one month of use, and each plan includes a different amount.

| Metric | Hobby | Pro | Enterprise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Purges | 1,000 / month | 2,000 / month | Custom |

Purges counts the purge operations the account runs in the month. Tiered Cache is included on every plan. The pricing page lists data transfer under [Application Accelerator](/en/documentation/build/application-accelerator/): 1 TB / month on Hobby, 2 TB / month on Pro, and Custom on Enterprise. Cache variation, which that page lists as Custom Cache Keys, and path rewrites are included on every plan.

The plan decides what happens past an included amount. On Hobby, use beyond the included amount may require an upgrade, and Azion may restrict the account. On Pro and Enterprise, Azion bills the additional consumption at on-demand rates, and configurable spend limits bound the additional charge. For the rates, refer to [Pricing](/en/documentation/fundamentals/pricing/#cache). To read the data Tiered Cache has transferred so far, refer to [Query usage data from Tiered Cache](/en/documentation/guides/platform/observability/query-tiered-cache-usage-data-with-graphql/).
